To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ray shooting problem can be solved in O(log n)-time for simple polygons and in O(log^2 n) time for polygonal obstacles.

(a) the query time can be reduced to O(log n) if the query ray is known in advance; (b) the preprocessing time can be reduced from O(n logn) to O(n log n) if the set of query rays is known in advance, and (c) both preprocessing time and query time can be further reduced to O(n + k log n) if both the set of query ray and the query ray are known in advance.
